posts.name: Singlog
posts.cooked:
Oh the font is smaller, ergo it is not as big as it was in word Alright, time for some assumptions I made.

  1. Baron Blade was imprisoned for the death of Legacy Sr. This would mean he only fought the current Legacy once and found him to be bullet proof.
  2. Baron Blade would have an escape plan in case he did fail and get caught
  3. Baron Blade escapes immediately, and Legacy would be able to find out that the man who killed his father is free relatively quickly
  4. Baron Blade believes everyone is intellectually inferior
  5. Baron Blade would have some sort of way to get data on his enemies (in the form of nano-bots in this story)
  6. Baron Blade is emotionally stressed because this new Legacy is much stronger than the old one
  7. Baron Blade knows that the Parsons are Legacys
  8. Baron Blade is smart enough, even with his sanity strained, to know that he would not survive the impact if he stayed on Earth
  9. Baron Blade experiences mood swings.
  10. Baron Blade sees no value in human life other than his own.

That’s about it! I hope you all like this little story. I have to applaud whoever did the art for his HP tracker, because that is what really got me thinking about it. And also thanks to whoever runs their twitter fo allowing me to use their characters and setting. My teacher is worried about stuff like that for some reason. And finally, thanks to the enire theam at >G for making a stupidly fun game!

Edited for clarity

posts.name: chainsawrabbit
posts.cooked:
Your rendition of Baron Blade makes me think of all the best (worst?) parts of Doctor Doom and Cobra Commander, given a more tangible history that some people can actually relate to. (I don’t know many people who can identify with unabashed megalomaniacs.) The Baron is one of those folk who could do great things for the world if his own view of it didn’t poison him. I brings a tear to my eye when something captures the source material while being truly worthy of it.

It also makes me a tiny bit jealous that nothing I’ve ever written has been this cool… but still, awesome expanded-universe goodness!

Bravo!

-CSR

Yeah, the reason why I had him push the Moon into the Earthas opposed to pulling it, is that he would realize that he would be at ground zero and will most likely die. I can accept that he is so egotistical that he thinks he can live.

One thing that I wanted to get through was that he was desprate to the point of insanity. He had just killed one Legacy only to find that a new one had already discovered his powers, and has impenitrible skin. I don’t think that I made it clear enough. However, we are apperently going to have the class critique our stories, so I might be able to add a few things to make it come through. And now that I see the attachment button, I’ll just add the word document!

posts.name: Singlog
posts.cooked: I didn’t think of laser vision being Young Legacy exclusive (although I should have with the card) but I knew America’s Finest had developed impenetrable skin. After Christopher said that Baron Blade’s plan are usually so bad they failed, I thought of the most expensive way to kill Legacy’s Dad, so I thought an entire army of robotic minions fit the bill. Then I remembered that the former Legacy did not have bullet proof skin, and I thought that Baron Blade would love to have an anti-climatic end to his foe, so I then added the assassin bit.
